texts.preamble: Amara Bala Krishna vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 5 July, 2022 Author: Ninala Jayasurya Bench: Ninala Jayasurya Hon'Ble Sri Justice Ninala Jayasurya Criminal Petition No.4712 Of 2022 Between:- Amara Bala Krishna ... Petitioner/Accused and The State of Andhra Pradesh represented by Represented by its Public Prosecutor. ... Respondent Counsel for the petitioners : Mr.Raja Reddy Koneti Counsel for the respondent : The Public Prosecutor
texts.facts: 2. The present Criminal Petition has been filed seeking to quash the proceedings against the petitioner in Crime No.500 of 2021 on the file of Ongole I-Town Police Station, Prakasam District registered for the offences punishable under Section 272 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, Section 20(2), 24(1) of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003 and Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, and consequently direct the concerned Station House Officer to return the tobacco products seized in connection with the Crime.
texts.arguments: 3. The learned counsel for the petitioner while placing reliance on the decision of this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27.8.2018, submits that the matter is squarely covered by the said decision and the present Criminal Petition deserves to be allowed by quashing the proceedings against the petitioner.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 3. The learned counsel for the petitioner while placing reliance on the decision of this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27.8.2018, submits that the matter is squarely covered by the said decision and the present Criminal Petition deserves to be allowed by quashing the proceedings against the petitioner.
